blocks.text: This article describes how to add IP location groups. You can add up to 4,096 IP location groups. You can also use a CSV file to import multiple location groups.

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Administration > Authentication > Trusted IP Location Groups.
On the Location Groups page, click Add Location Group.
The Add Location Group drawer appears.
In the Add Location Group drawer:
Name: Enter a name for the location group.
Description: Enter a description or notes for the location group.

Locations: Select the locations that you want to assign to this group. Click the checkbox against the location to add them to the group. Click the X icon to remove a location or Clear All at any time. You can add up to 2,048 locations.
